derivation: amendment A13: an element self-closed as <svg/> opens nothing, so the following invalid en_US link is scanned and reported.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<svg/>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en_US" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: structure-svg-selfclosed
